name: demo-cta
description: Closing demo card: dark gradient panel with copy and a pull quote beside a demo form or button. Live: the `.ap-fire-footer-cta` card that closes every vertical page.

form_id.description: Identifier for the form mount point, which the site's form script fills. Empty renders the button instead.

hubspot_portal.description: HubSpot portal ID for the demo form (digits).

hubspot_region.description: HubSpot region, e.g. na1 or na2.

form_placeholders.description: Placeholder text per HubSpot field name (lower-case), set once the form is ready. The key textarea covers any message box that has none.

form_submit.description: Submit button text, set once the form is ready. Empty keeps HubSpot's.

background.description: Backdrop art behind the form card, stretched to the section (live: the site footer art).

image.description: Product image on the right, used instead of a form.

cta_label.description: Button text, used when there is no form. Renders only with cta_url.

variant.description: platform: the Asset Intelligence Platform page keeps the image card's heading tightly tracked (the hub and solution pages set it at normal tracking). hub: the industry hubs' closing band (live #ap-gov-fcta). eduhub: the Education hub's closing band (live #ap-eduhub-fcta).

image_width.description: Hub variants: the product image's intrinsic width, written on the so the band keeps its height while the image loads. 0 omits it.

image_height.description: Hub variants: the product image's intrinsic height. 0 omits it.

anchor.description: Default and platform variants: id on the section, so buttons elsewhere on the page can jump to the form (letters, digits, hyphens), e.g. partner-registration.

bullets.description: Default and platform variants: a check list under the paragraph (plain strings), each with a green circle-check.

panel.description: plain: the form sits straight on the gradient card (the product pages). card: the form sits in a white rounded card, copy and form share the row equally and the copy top-aligns with the card (Figma Footer CTA Card with Booking form; Partners).
